prompt: Give me an explanation on how a website was developed
judge_reasoning: Perception scan: found 4 candidate markers ([1]-[4], N=4). Constraint checklist: target is an explanation of how a website is developed, ideally covering end-to-end stages rather than only UI work or only front/back distinctions. Candidate [1] best matches with a complete planning→design→front/back→testing→deployment→maintenance sequence; [4] is also strong and comprehensive but framed more as a web developer’s role. Candidate [2] is only partially aligned because it focuses mainly on UI design, and [3] is least aligned by centering on front-end vs back-end differences instead of the overall development process.
